headline: Newmont Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates with Record Cash Flow
summary: Gold miner Newmont reported third-quarter 2026 financial results that exceeded Wall Street estimates, supported by record quarterly cash flow.
why: Newmont Corporation is the world's largest gold mining company by production and market capitalization.

impacts.name: Newmont Corporation
impacts.why: Strong Q3 earnings beat and record cash flow support higher profitability expectations.

why_moved: Newmont reported Q3 results above market estimates driven by record quarterly cash flow.
